name: Block Description Modifier
description: Configure how Layout Builder inline blocks populate and optionally hide the Block description (block_content.info).

suggests.drupal/inline_entity_form: Recommended if you edit referenced Custom Blocks in embedded subforms (ensures consistent UI/behavior in nested editing flows).

project_description: Auto-fills and optionally hides the "Block description (info)" field (block_content.info) for Custom Blocks, both when they are used as Layout Builder inline blocks and when edited on regular block_content add/edit forms. A central admin page lists every Custom Block type (block_content bundle) and lets you configure, per bundle and per mode (inline / content), how the info value is generated using a pluggable strategy: a fixed string (max 60 chars), the block type (bundle) label, or a copy of a chosen text field on the block. When enabled the module hides the info/title inputs in the relevant forms and enforces the computed value on submit and on entity presave; empty or missing sources fall back to the literal "corrupted field". Storage moved in 1.1.0 to one config entity per bundle (block_description_modifier.bundle.*, entity type bdm_bundle), replacing the legacy single block_description_modifier.settings object; a hook_update migrates existing sites. Integrates with Inline Entity Form so the same content-block rules apply to block_content edited inside nested subforms. All configuration is gated behind the 'administer block description modifier' permission.
